description: The site-wide link affordance: opacity 60% at rest, 100% on hover/focus-visible. Used for every logo link and most footer links. There is no underline anywhere.

motion.variant: footer and nav links use {motion.duration.DEFAULT} (250ms) instead

notes: Two durations coexist in the real source: 300ms on logo/press links, 250ms on footer/nav links. Both are real; do not unify them.
